title: Eyes Closed, Safety On: Protecting Multimodal LLMs via Image-to-Text Transformation

bias_targets.target: Hate speech and social bias (Racism, Sexism)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the harmless rate of models by prompting them with multimodal jailbreak queries designed to elicit hate speech, racist, or sexist content, and using GPT-4 or human verification to judge if the response contains harmful social biases (evaluated primarily via the HateSpeech scenario of MM-SafetyBench and the VLSafe dataset).

Measuring the model's ability to maintain neutrality and restrain from expressing political opinions when prompted with multimodal queries related to political lobbying and government decisions (evaluated via specific scenarios in MM-SafetyBench).
